parsed.explanation: Combined regime: self-governing territory with own courts; parent equality/single-sex rules not documented extended, so no inherited exposure. No trans-specific criminalisation, border exclusion, facility bans, care denial or custody rules are documented. Protective law includes gender-reassignment discrimination protection in services and trans hate-crime/harassment offences, although trans-inclusive enforcement is recent and untested. Missing legal gender recognition is primarily a resident gap, but visitors are read through home-document markers, leaving uncertain screening, facilities, emergency care, detention, and minor-specific consequences. Severity after outing appears low, with rule-of-law recourse plausible; probability of outing exists but no documented escalation.

entry_documents.exposure: Visitor is read at border/public under home-document marker; mismatch possible but no documented refusal, search or humiliation.
entry_documents.protection: Equal Opportunities Act prohibits gender-reassignment discrimination in goods/services; no visitor exclusion statute.
entry_documents.interaction: Local lack of gender-marker change affects residents more than visitors; only matters if officials doubt foreign documents.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Not documented; no detention or birth-sex placement evidence for visitors.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Hate-crime law, courts and rights framework suggest legal remedy if targeted.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: If custody follows document mismatch, outcome unknown; no local marker change could complicate records.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No parent or federal facility access rules documented extended to territory; subnational variation not documented.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Territory’s discrimination protection may cover service refusal if operative.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Parent equality act/single-sex code not applied unless extended; not assumed.

care_services.exposure: Not documented; no care refusal, ward placement, HRT or emergency-care rule.
care_services.protection: Gender-reassignment discrimination ban applies to goods/services, potentially clinics/hospitals.
care_services.interaction: Care access would depend on local practice and whether service-provision law is enforced.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: No state threat framing or organized targeting documented; conversion-therapy scope and trans hate-crime enforcement uncertain.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Trans-identity hate-crime/harassment law passed 2026; official condemnation of anti-gay abuse; independent courts.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Recent law may deter harm but cannot be credited as operating without enforcement data.

minors_guardians.exposure: No minor-specific restrictions, school, custody or family-visiting risk documented; marker uncertainty may affect administrative placement.
minors_guardians.protection: Adoption/open family law, equal consent age, non-criminalisation; no documented guardian penalties.
minors_guardians.interaction: A travelling parent could face unclear school/medical administration if minor is outed.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No trans-specific attacks or police abuse against travellers documented; only dated anti-gay abuse incident.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Hate-crime legislation and service-discrimination law; functioning courts and oversight expected.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police response unknown for trans victims; social polarisation from marriage consultation suggests possible friction.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Open questions: border screening, facilities, custody, care, enforcement of 2026 trans protections.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Equal-opportunity complaints framework, hate-crime law, courts; no evidence these were tested for trans visitors.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Absence of negative records in rights-rich dossier helps but cannot prove safe operations.

anchor_checks.comparison: No care-refusal incident documented; protections on books are similar. Here there is no documented clinic panel refusal, but also no care enforcement data, placing it near or slightly above that vignette.
Vignette has border training and review tribunal. This dossier lacks border/care specifics and trans enforcement records, so it is somewhat lower than 0.75-C, but has no documented detention.
Vignette has enforced equality law and trained police. This territory has laws but no documented facility/border enforcement or trans hate-crime operation, so it sits below 0.85-A.

parsed.synthesis: The operative regime is locally protective rather than locally punitive: no criminalisation of trans status, no documented visitor-facing screening or facility rule, and discrimination protection in services. Parent single-sex/equality rules do not enter unless extended, and that extension is not documented. Risk is uncertainty around enforcement, document-marker scrutiny, facilities, custody, care, and minors rather than severe consequences. Severity after discovery appears low and institutions function, so the rating is reduced-risk; it is not higher because key traveller-facing protections are untested for trans visitors.
